name: Social Content Image Set
description: From the brand, product or campaign goal, dynamically plan social platform copy, general visuals and per-platform adapted images.

planning.planning_notes: First generate one piece of core copy from the user goal, then dynamically create image plan items according to the platforms and count the user chose; create only the platform versions that are actually needed.
planning.prompt_guide: All platform versions share the brand facts and core messages, but composition, text density, aspect ratio and visual rhythm should fit each platform.
conduct_rules: Dynamically decide the number of nodes from platforms and image_count
The same set of content must keep the brand, product and core selling points consistent
Use for each platform only the Recipe that matches its delivery format
Generate and confirm the dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Brand information is consistent, platform adaptation is accurate, and both copy and images are ready to use
Core content is complete; a few platform formats need adjustment
Platform adaptation is wrong or the brand information differs between versions

visual_review_items.name: Brand consistency
visual_review_items.description: The subject, brand and selling points stay consistent across the images of different platforms

visual_review_items.name: Platform adaptation
visual_review_items.description: Composition, aspect ratio and information density fit the target platform

text_review_items.name: Core message consistency
text_review_items.description: Copy on each platform does not alter the brand facts or core selling points

domain_constraints: Do not invent product features, prices, qualifications or campaign information
Different platform versions must share the same confirmed brand facts
